answer: The wall is Chartered towpath warden milepost log with towpath wardens standing. Each brick is three-year wardening, 250 supervised miles, theory exam, annual re-assessment, laid by a different hand, in a different year. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 529 fakes spends 7935 minutes per epoch, forever. The opal is the signature, the beacon is the fee, and the meadow is the register where both are written down. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
